name: Bera / Iris
purpose: Select a visual atmosphere and adjust its light intensity.

exports.Iris: Optical instrument and two synchronized intensity controls

component.composition: Render Iris and IrisAtmospheres with the same controlled value and onChange. Iris owns material rendering and light adjustment; IrisAtmospheres owns preset selection. The host applies exported palette tokens to surrounding surfaces.

principles: Touch and keyboard are first-class inputs

behavior.pointer: Move over the lens to redirect its light. Drag the outer handle to adjust intensity.
behavior.touch: Drag the handle or use the linear slider. The lens does not capture page scrolling.
behavior.keyboard: Radio-group arrow navigation. Both intensity sliders support arrow keys, Home, End, PageUp, and PageDown.
behavior.fallback: Controls remain functional without WebGL. The lens recovers when its graphics context is restored.
behavior.idle: Rendering stops when interpolation settles, when offscreen, or when the document is hidden.
behavior.persistence: None. Controlled state belongs to the host application.

guardrails: Preserve controlled state and input semantics
Do not add looping ambient animation
Keep geometry relative to the component, not the viewport
Do not add unrelated cards or decorative statistics
Validate at narrow mobile widths and with reduced motion
